name: MGallery Bangkok Vie Hotel
positioning: VIE Hotel Bangkok - MGallery Collection: a design hotel by French architect J + H Boiffils, steps from Ratchathewi BTS station and within walking distance of Siam
best_for: Travelers who want a central Bangkok base close to the Skytrain and Siam shopping
Guests who want a rooftop infinity pool with city and sunset views

facts.text: The hotel is steps from the BTS Skytrain Ratchathewi station and within walking distance of the Siam shopping district.
Siam Square is a 10-minute walk from the hotel.
The hotel is near the Airport Rail Link, making it easy to travel between the airport and the city.
The hotel was designed by French architect J + H Boiffils, with works of art, exotic furniture, soft shades and bold colors.
The decor mixes luxury and minimalism.
Asian design accents feature in the rooms.
VIE Spa is built around a journey through the world of scents.
The hotel has a fitness room.
Piano Bar has Art Deco interiors, lounge seating and jazz.
La VIE Bistronomy is a casual all-day dining venue.
Jim Thompson House is among the attractions near the hotel.
The hotel is LGBTQ+ friendly and family-friendly.

highlights.text: The rooftop infinity pool has a glass screen at its end, so guests feel as though they are swimming towards the horizon.
Rooms and suites have high ceilings and floor-to-ceiling windows with views across the city.
VIE Spa's signature treatment is the Aromatic Candle Massage.
At dusk, poolside tables and chairs at The Edge Pool Bar let guests watch the sunset over a cocktail.

considerations.text: WhataHotel notes that the city-center location may bring some city noise.
